scope: Delphi 3e18 39-bucket paired one-phase and two-phase fit rows

data_use.development: append-only 3e18 heldouts, evaluated once after candidate freeze

common_model.aggregate_spine: SFOS39 independently fit for each target
common_model.target_balance: each target's paired residual block is divided by its fit-only delta RMS
common_model.constraints: Jensen coefficients are nonnegative; recency coefficient is unconstrained

candidates.premise: the fraction of early learning retained at evaluation is schedule-specific and therefore shared across smooth targets; overload curvature remains target-specific
both recency and within-schedule overload are schedule-level invariants shared across smooth targets
the evaluation state values early and late response equally; only target-specific overload is learned

gates.paired_cv: improve or preserve phase-delta RMSE on both targets relative to separate fpt_total_global
gates.heldout: do not increase target-matched optimism count or regret materially on either target
gates.raw_surface: no claim of global optimum improvement unless a separate raw optimization audit is plausible
